name: The Shardmother
place: nests on the obsidian dunes west of Shardhaven, in a bowl lined with broken glass
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A glasswing with feathers of black glass that nests in shards. Her wingbeat throws you back and her dive lands on whoever is farthest. At half health she moults: her glass feathers rain down and stay on the sand as broken glass that cuts, and a gale of shards blows down three lines.

party.solo: Fair solo at 14; watch your footing.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The dune glitters, then lifts on two black glass wings.
A shriek like a pane cracking.
say.death: The Shardmother falls in a long tinkling crash.
say.reset: The Shardmother settles back on her glass nest.

wingbeat.name: Wingbeat
wingbeat.say: She beats her wings — hold on!

dive.name: Dive
dive.say: The Shardmother climbs and dives at {target}!

moult.name: Moult
moult.say: Glass feathers rain down — and stay where they land!

shard_gale.name: Shard Gale
shard_gale.say: A gale of shards blows out in front of her!

phases.name: Moulting
phases.say: The Shardmother shakes herself, and glass flies everywhere!
